description: Amid repeated safety failures and transnational incidents, a consortium of independent researchers, former regulators, and Global South institutions launches a 'Global AI Watchdog' initiative, publishing real-time risk assessments and model leak analyses. Though unfunded and informal, it gains media traction as the only source consistently flagging emergent dangers before official bodies react. This reflects the vacuum left by institutional underperformance and rising global concern over uncontrolled capability growth.
